brief:
The Gaza Works and Housing Ministry said Israeli authorities permit entry of shelter and relief supplies totaling just 5 percent of actual displacement needs, Shehab Wire reported. The ministry attributed the severe shortfall to ongoing restrictions on aid deliveries into the territory as the humanitarian crisis deepens.

Hundreds of thousands of Palestinians have been displaced across Gaza, creating urgent demand for tents and temporary housing. The 5 percent allowance falls drastically short of requirements to house the displaced population, according to the ministry statement. Humanitarian conditions continue to deteriorate as the shelter shortage persists, leaving displaced families without adequate protection from the elements.
